scope: Isolated real Astro static builds, not browser execution, owner approval or production expiry.

checks.fullSuite: Not repeated: 837 passing tests from FH20AB remain the baseline; this increment changes only QA script and documentation.

limitations: No browser layout or interaction verification.
Expiry scenario rebuilds at a future clock; already-published static HTML does not expire by itself.
Comparison renders six compatibility fields; Wi-Fi, BLE and Zigbee have no table rows.
Alternative cards contain profile links, not per-protocol claims.
Client marker scan excludes known review internals; quiz intentionally serializes qualified public signals.
